Initial release — convert your images into animated, shareable videos in seconds.

- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF (up to 200MB) as input; outputs crisp 1080p MP4 videos.
- Fast cloud-based processing (30–60 seconds per video).
- Simple setup: automatic free session/token creation for new users.
- Credits system for usage tracking; see balance any time.
- Clear workflows for upload, preview, editing, exporting, and troubleshooting.
- Error handling and user-friendly prompts for smooth experience.
